name: cut_list_in_the_drawing
why: ENTRY GT2. Since 17/9/2026 `drawing_cut_list` was in the catalogue with `Provata = false`: `InsertWeldmentTable` returned null in 24 combinations out of 24, and the entry said «the block is bigger than the entry». On 26/9 the cause: the frame was not a WELDMENT (`IsWeldment` false), and without the «Weldment» feature the automatic cut list is not born, and without the automatic cut list the table is not born. Now `cut_list` makes a weldment of the part, and the table is born: two items, 2 x 1000 and 2 x 800.
defect_caught: Three: the table that is not born (the part not a weldment), the table with all the bars in one row (the cut list made with `InsertWeldmentCutList2` on all the bodies: «4 x 1000»), and the table that sums a number of bars different from the part.
_the_views_are_called_by_uid: V1 front: the frame is on the front plane, and there the four bars are seen.

expect.why: four bars: the number the table is compared with
a view attaches to the FILE of the part
one row per length, under the header: with the cut list from before it would have been a single row, «4 x 1000»
the quantity column asked of the table template (GetColumnCustomProperty), not guessed by position
two independent readings of the same fact: the table on the sheet and the cut-list folders of the part
the 800 bar is written on the sheet: it is exactly the one the cut list from before lost

SEEN IN THE PNG on 26/9/2026, with the rest of the case green: the table of the workshop template has 17 columns and at 250/200 it ran off the sheet after the fourth. Now it is measured and goes in a free place inside the frame

the columns the workshop needs stay; the others (author, code, the duplicates QUANTITY and TOTAL LENGTH...) are hidden. The two literals are the headers the Italian workshop template PRINTS for the length and the quantity: SOLIDWORKS writes them, the repository does not choose them (window .8 had translated the second to «quantity column», a text no template prints, and the case went red; they are candidates for the solidworks-localized exceptions of .11)
